cnbc.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
cnbc.summary: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after resuming withdrawals following a $6.3 billion hack, representing 2.1% of its total assets.

cnbc.title: Democratic Rep. Stevens endorses Republican Rogers over rival El-Sayed in Michigan Senate election
cnbc.summary: Haley Stevens had lost the Democratic nomination for Senate in Michigan to Abdul El-Sayed earlier this year.

cnbc.title: Judge dismisses Alaska Senate election lawsuit; DOJ vows appeal
cnbc.summary: Democratic nominee Mary Peltola is facing two candidates named Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate election, one of whom is the Republican incumbent.

cnbc.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says
cnbc.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy's office announced Sunday that he suffered a stroke and was hospitalized the day prior, though they say he is 'awake and alert.'

cnbc.title: Why AI is boosting Meta's ad business while hurting Google search
cnbc.summary: The gap between Meta's ad revenue growth and Google's search expansion was the widest it's been since 2021 in the latest quarter.

cnbc.title: For JPMorgan, Amazon, fighting AI bots like Meta Muse may not be a winning long-term strategy
cnbc.summary: As companies from Amazon to JPMorgan block AI personal agents like Meta's Muse, retail experts warn that technology that removes customer friction usually wins.

cnbc.title: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice
cnbc.summary: President Donald Trump denied writing a birthday letter to sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, which was the subject of a 2025 Wall Street Journal article.

cnbc.title: These Senate races may help determine the fate of Social Security
cnbc.summary: Social Security's retirement trust fund may run out in 2032. Senators elected this November will be in office when that deadline comes.

cnbc.title: Social Security may have to cut retirement benefits in six years. Here's how much money is at stake for beneficiaries
cnbc.summary: The latest projections show Social Security may have to cut retirement benefits in six years. Here's what may happen if Congress doesn't prevent that.

cnbc.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
cnbc.summary: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.
